(2) UI login as B → chat opens, sent 'hello from Bob 1' and 'second line from Bob' — 0 'Unable to decrypt'. (3) UI login as A → sees Bob's messages IMMEDIATELY as plaintext (0 decrypt failures). A sent 'reply from Alice 1' + 'another from Alice' — visible plaintext. (4) Opened chat + media modal — ALL required toggles present & visible: media-viewonce-toggle, media-save-toggle, media-expire-Off/1h/24h/7d, media-pick-photo, media-pick-video. (5) Page reload as A → all 4 prior messages STILL render as plaintext, 0 decrypt banners. (6) Worries: added 'worried about R9B test' → shows plaintext ✓. (7) Mood: selected mood chip + note 'optimistic today R9B' → note plaintext ✓. (8) Gallery: /gallery renders the uploaded image (1 element, 0 decrypt errors) ✓. (9) Regression: wrong password on login shows login-error banner ✓; welcome→register/login navigation works ✓. Zero '🔒 Unable to decrypt' anywhere across all screens. No React Native red screen. Only pre-existing console warnings (shadow* deprecated, expo-notifications web unsupported) — none new. The pass-through crypto.ts (encryptMessage→{nonce:'',ciphertext:plain}, decryptMessage returns ciphertext as-is, encryptBytes/decryptBytes return raw bytes, deriveAndStoreKeypair/ensureKeypair→'e2e-off', getExistingPublicKey→null) works correctly with the unchanged backend which now stores plaintext in the nonce/ciphertext columns and raw bytes in media storage.

critical_code_review_comments: crypto.ts pass-through is correctly implemented: encryptMessage returns {nonce:'', ciphertext:plaintext}, decryptMessage returns ciphertext as-is (handles null via '??'). encryptBytes/decryptBytes are byte-identity. ensureKeypair/deriveAndStoreKeypair return constant 'e2e-off' so the AuthContext still has a non-empty public_key to POST at register time and existing 'if (partner?.public_key)' guards remain truthy.

server.py contract is unchanged and correctly agnostic: nonce/ciphertext are just opaque strings in the schema (MessageIn, WorryIn, CheckinIn) so they carry plaintext without any code changes. Media upload accepts base64 bytes and stores them raw via put_object; download returns them raw. view-once (consumed flag) and expire-on-first-open (expires_at) logic are untouched and continue to work — validated by round9 pytest.

Chat/Worries/Mood UI still call decryptMessage/decryptBytes on the client; since those pass through unchanged, the '🔒 Unable to decrypt' fallback in index.tsx L75/L127 and worries.tsx L51 will only fire if ciphertext is literally null — never for messages sent through the current build. VERIFIED via Playwright: 0 occurrences across all pages tested.
No _id leaks: server explicitly projects {'_id': 0} on all reads. Verified in test_send_and_list.
public_key='e2e-off' is a plain string sent by both signUp and signIn; register requires min_length=1, max_length=500 (server.py L219) — 'e2e-off' fits. No 400s.

context_for_next_testing_agent: E2E encryption is DISABLED (crypto.ts is a pass-through). Text messages, worries, checkin notes, and media all round-trip as plaintext / raw bytes. The screenshot-protection + media privacy features (view-once, auto-expire on first open, allow-save toggle) still work — validated at the API layer. The backend schema still names fields 'nonce' and 'ciphertext' but they now carry plaintext — don't be fooled into thinking encryption is broken. The only real thing to look at next is minor UI copy (chat/gallery headers still say 'Encrypted') and eventual cleanup renaming of encryptAndUpload/fetchAndDecryptMedia. Do NOT rely on Playwright to save-a-worry via clicking worry-save-button — the on-screen keyboard pushes it out of viewport on the web preview; blur the input and use JS .click() as a workaround (see round9 script).
rca_of_issue: Not a bug — this iteration is the intentional feature change to remove E2EE. Prior 'Unable to decrypt' failures were caused by keypair drift between installs (Round 8 attempted to fix via deterministic KDF but the user opted to remove encryption entirely). Current state: crypto.ts pass-through eliminates the entire class of decryption failures because there is no decryption. Verified by 0 'Unable to decrypt' banners across chat send-both-ways, chat reload, and gallery in the Playwright run, plus 10/10 backend contract tests passing.
